message: Last winter, as the snow piled up outside and the wind howled like an over-caffeinated cat, I decided to turn our living room into a cozy nest. I gathered blankets, made a big pot of soup, and dragged out the board games. We ended up having the most delightful evening, laughing and reminiscing while the storm raged on. Who knew a little weather could lead to such warmth inside? Sometimes, it’s all about how you frame the situation, isn't it? 🥣
